hero.subtitle: Digital Swiss francs, ZCHF. Save, borrow and pay with a decentralized currency backed by collateral you can see.

trust: Legal opinions under Swiss law and MiCA

products.title: One franc. Four ways to use it.

save.label: Save
save.title: Earn {rate} on Swiss francs
save.body: Deposit ZCHF in the savings module. Interest accrues every block, withdraw any time.

borrow.label: Borrow
borrow.title: Francs against BTC, ETH, gold or shares
borrow.body: Keep your exposure and mint ZCHF at fixed terms. No credit check.

invest.label: Invest
invest.title: Own a share of the system
invest.body: FCS, Frankencoin Shares, is the protocol's equity: a share of the reserve and a vote on how it is run. Its value can rise or fall.

pay.label: Pay
pay.title: Spend it like francs
pay.body: At Spar stores, with a GnosisPay card, or by bank transfer through a personal IBAN.

proof.title: Backed by collateral|you can see.
proof.subtitle: Borrowers lock assets in public contracts to mint ZCHF, so every franc is backed by more than a franc of collateral. Weak positions are challenged and auctioned, and borrowers' interest pays savers first.
proof.coins: Backed by {n} collateral types, every one on-chain

final.title: Swiss francs. On-chain. Yours.
final.subtitle: Start with any amount. No account with Frankencoin, no lock-up, your own keys.
